title: Guava aggregates done and reentrant futures in input order
summary: Both JRE and Android artifacts eliminated the callback registration on a completed future. The pending and reentrant repeated-input cases completed in input order on both pins.

change.description: The aggregate future reads a completed dependency directly, avoiding a listener registration while preserving the result of Futures.allAsList.

notes: Both published artifact variants ran on the same desktop JDK 21.
Each deployment checks the JDK fingerprint, ordered artifact digests, caller classes and original class providers. The same compiled caller runs both sides in fresh JVMs.
